The fixed benchmark test set is held out; for each seed the remaining development data is split 0.875/0.125 into training/validation by scaffold (all 22 training tasks); run i (i = 0–4) uses benchmark split seed i and training-run seed i, giving seed-specific held-out validation partitions (the TDC reference protocol uses split seeds 1–5; because the test set is fixed, this affects only the training/validation partition). Prediction-level late-fusion candidate selection uses only these held-out validation predictions (no re-partitioning of the underlying data).

chemprop D-MPNN trained from scratch (no pretrained prior); message-passing depth=3, hidden d_h=300, backbone dropout=0.0. Identical architecture for STL and MTL; they differ only in the prediction head and optimization (see below).

Frozen graphmvp_hybrid.pth (regression variant), 5-layer GIN, emb_dim=300, JK=last, mean pooling; AdapterGNN (paper variant), bottleneck r=64, adapter dropout=0.0. Same bottleneck for STL and MTL.

MoLFormer-XL (ibm/MoLFormer-XL-both-10pct), precomputed tokens, max_len=202; LoRA on query/value projections: rank=16, alpha=32, dropout=0.1. Same LoRA configuration for STL and MTL (LoRA dropout is raised to 0.2 only inside the MAP joint-fusion model).

Modality Attention Pooling (MAP; implemented as robust_attention in the released code) over the CheMeleon + GraphMVP + MoLFormer encoders; output_dim=300, entropy-regularization weight=0.01, attention-temperature annealing from τ = 3.0 to 0.5 over 15 epochs, modality_dropout=0.2, residual + pre-norm. Constituent encoders use the same frozen priors / PEFT settings as above (MoLFormer LoRA dropout=0.2 here).

Grouped prediction head (GroupedHead over taskset_grouping in the released code) with one branch per mechanism group (the six groups of Table S11); trunk_hidden=128, head dropout=0.4; Kendall task-uncertainty weighting.
Single-task bottleneck head (one head per endpoint, single-task loss); no cross-task weighting.

AdamW with early stopping on validation, max_epochs=100, patience=15 for all models. STL base models: base lr=1e-3, batch size 32, precision 32-true. MTL and MAP joint-fusion: base lr=5e-4, batch size 16, precision bf16-mixed. LoRA parameter group lr=5e-5 (MoLFormer and the MAP module); MAP fusion-module lr_fusion=1e-4.
